submission.justification: G1 gives the best simulated time resolution (0.914 ns at 2.0 mm), better than G2 (1.275 ns at 2.25 mm) and G3 (1.898 ns at 1.75 mm). However, no GWP data was found in the project documents, so compliance with the hard GWP100 <= 150 limit is unverified for every candidate. The recommendation is conditional on confirming G1's GWP. If G1 exceeds 150, fall back to G2 or G3 once their GWP is verified.
